Description
Glattal Biologics is a contract development and manufacturing organisation (CDMO) for the aseptic fill and finish of biologics, with 460 employees at our site in Zurich-Altstetten. We fill vials and prefilled syringes for clinical and commercial supply for customers in Europe and the US.

Following a Swissmedic GMP inspection in June with two major observations, and ahead of an FDA pre-approval inspection expected in Q2 2027, we are looking for an experienced interim Head of Quality Assurance. Our Head of QA is on long-term leave.

Your responsibilities
• Lead the QA organisation with 38 employees (QA operations, QA systems, QA validation, batch record review)
• Act as Responsible Person (Fachtechnisch verantwortliche Person, FvP) towards Swissmedic after a short handover
• Drive the CAPA plan for the Swissmedic observations and track its effectiveness
• Close the remaining gaps to the revised EU GMP Annex 1 (contamination control strategy, environmental monitoring, aseptic process simulation)
• Prepare the site for the FDA pre-approval inspection, including mock inspections and a data integrity review
• Reduce the deviation and CAPA backlog in Veeva Vault QMS
• Represent QA in customer audits and quality agreements

Your profile
• Pharmacist or degree in natural sciences, eligible as FvP under Swiss law; EU Qualified Person status is a plus
• 10+ years in pharmaceutical quality assurance, of which at least 5 years in a leadership role in sterile manufacturing
• Hands-on experience with Swissmedic and FDA inspections and with remediation after inspection findings
• Strong knowledge of EU GMP Annex 1, ICH Q9 and Q10 and data integrity
• Fluent English and German

Conditions
• Start as soon as possible, 9 months with an option to extend
• On site in Zurich four days per week, one day remote
• Daily rate CHF 1,450 to 1,600, invoiced monthly; travel and accommodation covered for candidates from abroad
• Freelance contract directly with Glattal Biologics AG
